title: The Invisible Boy
author: Trudy Ludwig

hero.name: Brian
hero.description: A quiet boy who feels invisible at school, illustrated as a faint grey outline among colourful classmates
hero.source_note: Named character with distinctive grey/outline art style — source from Creative Fabrica or TPT clip art

notes: The core theme of this book is inclusion, belonging, and the power of small acts of kindness. Vocabulary prioritises social-emotional words relevant to the story. 'Invite' is critical as the turning point involves a new student Justin inviting Brian to join his lunch group. 'Draw' reflects Brian's key self-expression activity throughout. The grey-outline illustration style of Brian is distinctive and will not be matched by any generic Boardmaker boy icon — sourcing a character-specific PNG is strongly recommended for student recognition.
